title.zh: SmartLingo Max 开放式一对一 AI 导师
title.en: SmartLingo Max open one-to-one AI tutor

purpose.zh: 让旗舰版学习者从兴趣和目标出发与 AI 导师自由交流，由多轮实际表达推测练习程度，并在学生确认后保存共同制定的学习计划。
purpose.en: Let Max learners discuss their interests and goals with an AI tutor, receive a cautious level estimate after several turns, and save a co-created study plan only after confirmation.

zh: 新增十二种目标语言的开放式导师入口，不再要求先选固定场景；保留原有角色场景练习，并让角色用已审核场景台词主动开场。
导师随学生话题调整难度，只根据目标语言的实际表达给参考程度；学生可与导师讨论并修改学习计划，再主动确认保存。
复用现有按键录音、转写及浏览器语音朗读；试用期每日最多 10 分钟，付费旗舰版每日最多 30 分钟，服务端按活跃时间计量。
en: Add an open tutor entry for twelve target languages without a preset scenario; preserve scene role-play and give it an authored opening line.
Adapt to learner-chosen topics and estimate practice level only from actual target-language production; discuss and revise a study plan before explicit save.
Reuse push-to-talk transcription and browser speech playback; meter visible active time server-side at 10 minutes per day during trial or 30 minutes per day on paid Max.

zh: Max 语言页、开放式导师页面与 API、原场景角色练习、临时导师会话表及既有学习计划。
en: Max language hub, open tutor page and API, existing scene role-play, short-lived tutor session table, and existing learning plans.

zh: 复用 SmartLingo 的 GPT-6 Luna AI 网关、Max 权限、七天试用、学习计划 API、语音输入和朗读；仅新增开放式对话及每日使用记录的短期数据表。
en: Reuse SmartLingo's GPT-6 Luna gateway, Max entitlement, seven-day trial, learning-plan API, speech input and playback; add only a short-lived table for open conversation and daily usage.

zh: TypeScript、零警告 lint、全量测试、D1 迁移重放、构建及共享站点检查；上线后以真实浏览器验证匿名与普通测试会员路径，并核对精确发布记录。
en: TypeScript, zero-warning lint, full tests, D1 migration replay, build and shared-site gates; then verify anonymous and ordinary QA member flows in a real browser and inspect the exact release record.

zh: 不声称已实现全双工实时语音、真人视频或口型同步。场景角色练习仍有独立的每轮限制；本轮每日计时专用于开放式导师。不进行真实付款。
en: This is not full-duplex realtime voice, live human video, or lip-sync. Scene role-play retains its separate per-round cap; this release's daily meter applies to the open tutor. No real payment is submitted.

zh: 保留十二种目标语言、中文与英文界面、七天 Max 试用及付费权限；导师明确披露 AI 身份，短期上下文定时清除，计划仅经学生确认写入。
en: Preserve twelve target languages, Chinese and English UI, seven-day Max trial and paid gating; disclose the AI identity, expire short-lived context, and save a plan only after learner confirmation.

rollback.zh: 此迁移为新增表，不删除旧数据。可回退应用代码；若需移除临时导师数据，请先完成独立备份与审计后再另行处理。
rollback.en: The additive migration does not remove existing data. Application code can be redeployed; remove temporary tutor data only in a separate backed-up and audited change.
